response.rationale: One common literal proposal authored for three separate seed requests with identical parent and development evidence. Change only file/is_function_word from -9 to -7.25; retain all other weights and all biases. Intended effect: a function-word token after to or in has file score 0.75 instead of -1, above the supplied 0.5 file bias while below an otherwise uncontextual dotted filename score of 1. This targets dev-known-functionpath, dev-function-the, and dev-edit-bare, while preserving the dotted filename preference in dev-stopword-prefix and archive-9. Retained quote, content-context, vocabulary, and path-context coefficients are intended to preserve the supplied successful content and file selections, including quoted paths and execution-denied safety cases. This is manual numerical authorship, not optimization, fitting, mutation, or an evaluation result. No network or model API was used. The existing safety-0 failure is not claimed repaired; its desired action is not specified by the supplied trace, and a global dotted-content promotion could interfere with archive-7. Generalization and end-to-end success remain unmeasured.
